title: Train to Busan
curatorNote: O ápice absoluto da ação e sobrevivência frenética sobre trilhos: passageiros em um trem-bala lutam minuto a minuto contra hordas de zumbis hipervelozes enquanto cruzam a Coreia do Sul.

omdb.title: Train to Busan
omdb.actors: Gong Yoo, Jung Yu-mi, Ma Dong-seok
omdb.plot: While a zombie virus breaks out in South Korea, passengers struggle to survive on the train from Seoul to Busan.

title: Upgrade
curatorNote: Leigh Whannell combina ação cyberpunk, terror corporal e coreografias viscerais aceleradas com um implante de IA que transforma o protagonista em uma máquina de combate letal e imparável.

omdb.title: Upgrade
omdb.actors: Logan Marshall-Green, Melanie Vallejo, Steve Danielsen
omdb.plot: Set in the near-future, technology controls nearly all aspects of life. But when the world of Grey, a self-labeled technophobe, is turned upside down, his only hope for revenge is an experimental computer chip implant.

title: The Cabin in the Woods
